opening.argument: The speaker’s direct message is to leave the platform: viewers are told to take their money out, and the description warns that Davorcoin is following the Bitconnect pattern and will crash. Those statements frame the presentation as critical reporting about a cryptocurrency crash. The description also calls the platform safe to invest in, and the displayed webpage shows lending-rate figures and a “Register Now” button. Those promotional elements are visible, but the available speech places the investment claims in a warning context rather than clearly asking viewers to participate. The observable emphasis remains on withdrawal, not recruitment.
